data.description: Madinat Jumeirah Living is known for providing upscale and luxurious living spaces. The residences are designed with contemporary architecture and high-end finishes.

data.answer: Madinat Jumeirah Living is a free-hold community with a high-end lifestyle for its residents. The area is conveniently located just a 12-minute walk from Jumeira Public Beach and 500 yards from the Burj Al Arab. It consists of many apartments with fantastic amenities. These residences provide unparalleled views of the Burj Al Arab and the sea.

This 3.85 million square foot development features residential clusters amidst plenty of open spaces connected by pathways. Asayel, Rahaal, and Lamtara MJL are some of the most prominent ready-to-move developments in the community. These apartments have contemporary interiors and exquisitely designed lobby lounges.
Asayel Madinat Jumeirah Living offers 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartment collections featuring beautiful finishes and breathtaking views. To meet the demands of residents, the homes have wide lobbies, a variety of facilities, and concierge service.
Rahaal is a twin-tower complex connected with Madinat Jumeirah Resort through an air-conditioned footbridge. Lamtara MJL is another exquisite building that boasts Arabian architecture, featuring 1- to 4-bedroom apartments. All these apartments in Madinat Jumeirah Living are available for rent and sale.

Off-Plan Projects In Madinat Jumeirah Living

When considering investment options in Madinat Jumeirah Living, buyers often weigh the benefits of off-plan vs. ready properties. While ready properties provide immediate occupancy and a clear understanding of the living environment, off-plan units offer the potential for customization and lower initial costs.

One of MJL Dubai’s off-plan developments is Elara by Meraas. The modern development offers 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, the prices of which start at AED 2.30M. This Madinat Jumeirah Living Meraas project is expected to be handed over in 2026.

Another desirable Madinat Jumeirah Living apartments are Jomana, adjacent to Madinat Jumeirah Living Park. The complex's 1- to 4-bedroom apartments will offer a modern, serene, and tranquil living environment, with prices starting at AED 1.91M.

Lamaa is also one of the off-plan Madinat Jumeirah Living project. Investors can choose from 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments that have been thoughtfully created for their sophisticated resident. The property has a starting price of AED 1.45M, while the handover is expected in 2025.

Al Jazi Madinat Jumeirah Living is in the center of the area and overlooks vast green areas with recreational activities. The neighborhood is tranquil and pleasant, with views of the Burj Al Arab, and is ideal for families. Pick from the 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartment options. 

Moreover, Jadeel is one of the most attractive properties in Madinat Jumeirah Living, comprising 1 to 4-bedroom apartments. Boasting Arabesque architecture, the property will be handed over in 2025.

You can check out the payment plans, completion date and other details about these off plan projects on Zoya Ventures Real Estate. Moreover, our expert agents can help you get a mortgage at the best terms and rates for your chosen property.

Renting A Property In Madinat Jumeirah Living

Many units are available for rent in Asayel, Rahaal, and Lamtara developments in MJL Dubai. You can find a 1-bedroom apartment starting from AED 105k, while 2-BHK units are available for as low as AED 185k. AED 275k is the minimum rental price for a 3-bedroom apartment in Madinat Jumeirah Living. Note that for a 4-bedroom unit, you have to pay about AED 430k.

Buying A Property In Madinat Jumeirah Living

There are also many properties in Madinat Jumeirah Living for sale. A 1-bedroom flat in Madinat Jumeirah Living is available for AED 1.55M, whereas a 2-bedroom unit is AED 2.45M. For a 3-bedroom flat, you need to pay AED 2.55M, and 4-BHK units, buyers need AED 8.10M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Madinat Jumeirah Living?

data.answer:
Madinat Jumeirah Living is a luxury residential development in Dubai, offering a high standard of living with a mix of modern amenities and a convenient location. The Madinat Jumeirah Resort's world-class dining options, entertainment venues, exclusive beaches, and retail spaces are easily accessible from the Jumeirah Living Community.

Public Transportation In Madinat Jumeirah Living

The iconic Madinat Jumeirah Living is connected to the rest of the city via public transportation. If you take a tram, you can drop off at the Dubai Media City station to find a bus to the community. Alternatively, you can hop on a bus from the Mall of the Emirates Metro Station, Mashreq Metro Station, or Dubai Internet City Metro Station. Here are the buses you can take to reach the nearest bus stops to the community:

  • Bus 88 - Madinat Jumeirah Bus Stop
  • Bus 81 - Dubai Police Academy Bus Stop

Also, those who drive can use Sheikh Zayed Road or Al Sufouh Road to reach other areas from Madinat Jumeirah Living. 

Supermarkets in Madinat Jumeirah Living

Concerning grocery stores, various choices are available in the vicinity, such as Spinneys, Carrefour, and Waitrose. Additionally, residents have access to an array of specialty stores and boutique shops to meet their everyday grocery requirements. 

Shopping Malls In Madinat Jumeirah Living

You can visit Jumeirah Madinat Souk, an excellent retail destination just minutes from Madinat Jumeirah Living. The souk offers a mix of over 75 shops, boutiques, and galleries. Visitors can find a diverse list of products, including traditional handicrafts, clothing, jewelry, home décor, and souvenirs. The Souk is known for its collection of both local and international brands. Moreover, residents can use the traditional abra (water taxi) rides along the canals to reach the souk from the community.
You can also explore The Mall opposite Jumeirah Beach Hotel, Burj Al Arab, and Wild Wadi. The Mall contributes to Jumeirah's vibrant atmosphere, enhancing its lively and dynamic ambiance.

Schools and Nurseries in Madinat Jumeirah Living

Numerous schools are near Madinat Jumeirah Living, such as Jumeirah College, GEMS Wellington International School, and Emirates International School. These educational institutions present diverse curriculums and programs, offering families a broad spectrum of choices for their children's schooling. All these educational institutes are about 10 minutes away from Madinat Jumeirah Living.

Churches, Temples And Mosques In Madinat Jumeirah Living

The grand Jumeirah Mosque in the Jumeirah community is about 20 minutes away from Madinat Jumeirah Living. Umm Al Sheif Mosque is about 15 minutes away from the community. The Dubai Temple is located in Jebel Ali, a 15-minute drive from the properties in the area, while the nearby church is the Dubai Evangelical Church Centre.

Clinics And Hospitals In Madinat Jumeirah Living

Regarding healthcare amenities, the closest hospitals include Al Zahra Hospital Dubai, which is around 10 minutes away. Dubai London Clinic and Speciality Hospital, and Emirates Hospital Jumeirah are the other nearest healthcare options for Madinat Jumeirah Living residents. 

Madinat Jumeirah Living Location And Nearby Areas

Madinat Jumeirah Living is situated in the Umm Suqeim district, near the coastline of the Arabian Gulf. It is well-connected to key areas in Dubai and enjoys a strategic location within the city. Al Quoz, Al Barsha, Al Safouh and Al Safa re some of the neighboring communities of Madinat Jumeirah Living.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Madinat Jumeirah Living

data.answer:
Madinat Jumeirah Living provides a variety of dining options.
You can also find hotels, beaches, and other attractions in close proximity. Also, you find various beauty and wellness services in the vicinity, encompassing salons, spas, and fitness centers.

Restaurants Near Madinat Jumeirah Living Dubai

Regarding dining choices, Madinat Jumeirah Living residents can try out diverse cuisines while staying close to the community. Notable nearby restaurants include Pierchic, which provides seafood and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, and Pai Thai, which specializes in authentic Thai cuisine. For a more laid-back dining experience, residents can explore Beachcombers restaurant, known for its relaxed atmosphere and Asian-inspired cuisine.
Moreover, nearby are the Souk Madinat Jumeirah restaurants. The Souk is known for its diverse dining options, from casual eateries to upscale restaurants, offering a mix of international and local cuisines.

Beaches Near Madinat Jumeirah Living

Madinat Jumeirah Living is near several beautiful beaches along the Arabian Gulf. Some notable beaches near Madinat Jumeirah Living include Jumeirah Beach, known for its pristine sandy shores and clear blue waters. It's a popular destination for residents and visitors alike, offering a range of beach activities, water sports, and stunning views of the iconic Burj Al Arab.
Located nearby, Kite Beach is a favorite spot for kite surfers. The beach features a jogging track, various water sports facilities, and a selection of cafes and food stalls.
Al Sufouh Beach is also a nearby option for beach lovers that offers beautiful views of the Palm Jumeirah and the Dubai Marina skyline. Sunset Beach and La Mer are the other nearby options nearby.

Hotels Near Madinat Jumeirah Living

Madinat Jumeirah is a luxurious resort complex in Dubai close to the Madinat Jumeirah district. Also, Burj Al Arab is located close to Madinat Jumeirah Living. Known for its distinctive sail-like structure, it symbolizes luxury and opulence.
Moreover, Al Qasr Hotel is a part of the Madinat Jumeirah resort and is a luxurious hotel designed in a royal summer residence style. It offers upscale accommodations and amenities.
Mina A'Salam Hotel is another hotel within the Madinat Jumeirah complex, Mina A'Salam, translates to "Harbor of Peace." It provides a blend of traditional Arabian style and modern comfort.
The Jumeirah Beach Hotel is also situated nearby, a renowned beachfront property with a distinctive wave-like design. It offers a range of dining options, water sports, and recreational facilities.
One&Only Royal Mirage, this upscale resort is not far from Madinat Jumeirah Living either. It offers a luxurious escape with elegant rooms, multiple restaurants, and private beach access.
Attractions In Madinat Jumeirah

The Madinat Jumeirah Resort has various restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues, an excellent option for residents of the area. Also, Burj Al Arab, a luxury hotel shaped like a sail, is close to Madinat Jumeirah Living. Positioned nearby, Wild Wadi is a popular water park offering a variety of water attractions and experiences.

While residing in Madinat Jumeirah offers numerous benefits, it's essential to take into account the property prices in the area, which may be comparatively steep in comparison to other developments in Dubai. Nevertheless, considering the abundance of amenities provided for residents, the elevated costs seem reasonable.

Amenities include swimming pools, fitness centers, parks, retail outlets, and play areas.

Yes, non-residents can buy property in MJL.

MJL is very close to major Dubai attractions like the Burj Al Arab, Wild Wadi Waterpark, and Jumeirah Beach.

Is public transportation accessible from MJL?

Yes, public transportation is accessible, including buses and nearby metro stations.

Yes, MJL is a good fit for families, offering a secure environment and family-friendly amenities.

nodes.about:

The development offers a curated selection of 1 to 4-bedroom luxury residences, each crafted with refined interiors, open layouts, and sweeping views of the Burj Al Arab and the Dubai skyline. nodes.title: Al Jazi
nodes.about:
Al Jazi, a project by the renowned Meraas Company in Dubai, belongs to the premium segment and is a group of four nine-storey buildings connected by a common podium. The buildings are designed in classical Arabian style, and the interiors in the residences are presented in a modern style with first-class finishing in warm colors. The adjacent territory of the complex is literally buried in greenery.

The total number of apartments in the complex is 378 units. Apartments are presented with 1 - 4 bedrooms, have private balconies or terraces, dressing room, separate bathroom and storage. Apartments with 2 - 4 bedrooms will have a separate room for staff. All residences are carefully designed in terms of convenience and practicality in everyday life.

The complex is located opposite the famous Burj Afl Arab hotel, made in the form of a sail. This is the view from part of the apartments in the Al Jazi residential complex.

On the common area is located key infrastructure of the complex, including comfortable recreation areas, swimming pool, fitness studio, playground and a large number of green areas.

Social and commercial infrastructure is also well developed. In walking distance there are kindergartens, supermarkets, cafes and restaurants and many other objects necessary for a comfortable life.
